}}'''Rhian''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Maiden of the Spear]].

== Appearance ==
She had gray eyes and reddish-brown hair. Mat and Perrin thought she could have passed for Rand’s aunt.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Rhian|comp}} 

== Activities ==
She is the eldest of three maidens visiting [[Stedding Tsofu|''Stedding'' Tsofu]] in order to trade for Ogier-sung wood.{{ref||comp}}

When she and the others encounter [[Rand al'Thor]] and the group of [[Shienar]] warriors, the Aiel and Shienarians nearly start fighting, but are reminded of the pact of peace within all ''steddings'' by [[Juin]].{{ref/book|2|35}}
